purpose: Define derived dependency-health status over exact required/optional dependency identities without silently enabling or replacing missing dependencies.

topics.name: Runtime Dependency Health
topics.purpose: Define derived dependency-health status over exact required/optional dependency identities without silently enabling or replacing missing dependencies.

semantics.dependency_rule: Health evaluation references exact dependency bindings.
semantics.required_rule: Failed required dependency may degrade/fail the dependent according to explicit policy.
semantics.optional_rule: Optional dependency failure follows explicit degraded behavior.
semantics.auto_rule: Health failure never auto-installs/enables a missing dependency.
semantics.identity_rule: Dependency health does not merge dependency/dependent identities.
semantics.authority_rule: Healthy dependency grants no additional rights.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant definitions, executions, evidence and runtime state use explicit identities and boundaries; visibility, file order, timestamps, transport reachability or UI placement never silently create semantic authority.

hard_gates.condition: optional failure kills component without policy
